title: Alternative Feature Extractors for IMAC
summary: CLIP similarity distributions overlap for honest decryptions and some visually distinct images; whether alternative extractors can improve IMAC's visual-correctness/security tradeoff remains open.

formal_statement.body: Find a feature extractor $\Phi$ whose similarity threshold yields a better IMAC visual-correctness/security tradeoff than CLIP.

scope.domain: Feature-extractor design for IMAC image authentication.
parameters: Φ: candidate feature extractor for IMAC
Similarity threshold: parameter governing the visual-correctness/security tradeoff
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether a feature extractor and similarity threshold can yield a better IMAC visual-correctness/security tradeoff than CLIP.

citations.label: Format-Preserving Compression-Tolerating Authenticated Encryption for Images

progress.summary: The source identifies overlap in CLIP similarity distributions and explicitly asks whether alternatives, including PhotoDNA-style perceptual hashing, can provide a better tradeoff for IMAC.
citation_labels: Alexandra Boldyreva et al., Format-Preserving Compression-Tolerating Authenticated Encryption for Images
